name: Ads Monthly MoM Report
description: Generate a full Google Ads month-over-month report on the 1st of each month. Deliver via workflow Then steps (Google Drive, email, or local archive).
notes: Runs on a calendar schedule (1st of each month, 9:00 Edmonton time).
Compare preset: last full calendar month vs the prior month.
Fetches the Ads bundle and runs the PPC reporting pipeline. Add Then steps for delivery.
Requires Google Ads (MCC + developer token + Connect), a 10-digit customer ID on the property, and an OpenRouter key.
